notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Evolution Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Crystalline Crawler and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by paying {2}{U}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
